headline: Pakistan's large-scale manufacturing output grew 0.67% year-on-year in August 2026 but fell 4.96% from July, Pakistan Bureau of Statistics data showed.

card.desc: Production fell 4.96% from July; July-August growth 1.85%

caption:
Pakistan's large-scale manufacturing grew 0.67% year-on-year in August 2026 but fell 4.96% from July, Dawn and The Express Tribune reported, citing Pakistan Bureau of Statistics data. Growth for July-August reached 1.85%, while iron and steel and fertiliser output declined.
